notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig and Wellwisher do not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Wellwisher.
There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Wellwisher by tapping it, causing you to gain at least three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Wellwisher.
Repeat.
